messages:
Lina Park: Quick sync to close out the precision profile follow-up. Goal: agree SDK shape + runtime discovery semantics so customers don't get surprised by fallbacks.
Ethan Zhao: Suggest minimal SDK fields: `precision_hint` (ordered list), `quality_basis_id`, `fallback_policy` (strict|best_effort|economy), `cost_bucket`, `compatibility_ttl_s`. Keep it small to avoid churn.
Noah Rivera: Runtime notes: `compatibility_ttl_s` lets us cache model->precision sets for N seconds. If a model is updated, we expire. Also we need to surface per-shard compatibility when models are sharded across runtimes.
Priya Kapoor: Streaming behavior: default should be no midstream switches. Add `streaming_compat: boolean` and `allow_midstream_switch: boolean` (default false). If `allow_midstream_switch=true` we must add a `precision_transition` marker in the stream so clients can handle discontinuities.
Ethan Zhao: Love the explicit `fallback_policy` instead of `allow_fallbacks` boolean. Example semantics: `strict` -> return error if requested precisions unsupported; `best_effort` -> pick highest-ranked supported precision; `economy` -> runtime can pick cheaper precision even if lower-ranked but must include `quality_estimate` in response.
Lina Park: Add two operational knobs: `fallback_sampling_rate` (0..1) for noisy alert control and a per-customer metric `precision_fallback_rate`. Ops wants an alert when fallback_rate > 1% for 10m.
infra-bot: Noted. Will create alert `ml.precision.fallback_rate.high` scoped by customer id.
Noah Rivera: Billing: attach `cost_bucket` label in request so downstream billing can map delta costs for FP8/INT4 usage. Also include `expected_latency_multiplier` on model metadata so SDK UIs can show relative perf for each precision.
Priya Kapoor: Edge case: partial support where only some layers quantize (e.g., attn heads in 8-bit, rest 4-bit). We should represent support as a list: `supported_precisions: [\"FP8\",\"INT8\"]` + `partial_support: true` + `partial_notes` string.
Ethan Zhao: Validation: SDK should call `/v1/models/:id/precision-support?at_commit=sha` before sending production traffic to avoid surprises. Provide a small client helper that caches the discovery result and honors `compatibility_ttl_s`.
Lina Park: UX: return a compact `PrecisionOutcome` with fields `final_precision`, `fallback_chain` (array), `quality_estimate` (optional), `warnings` (array). Keep machine-readable and renderable in consoles.
Priya Kapoor: Telemetry events list: `precision_request_submitted`, `precision_discovery_hit|miss`, `precision_negotiated`, `precision_fallbacked`, `precision_midstream_switch` (if allowed), `precision_quality_estimate`. Include `model_version` and `quality_basis_id` in payload.
Noah Rivera: Security/audit: tag each response with an immutable `precision_tag` that records the model commit, precision, and timestamp. This helps debugging and audits.
Ethan Zhao: Small JSON sketch for SDK payload: ```json
{ \"precision_hint\": [\"FP8\",\"INT8\",\"INT4\"], \"quality_basis_id\": \"qb-2023-09-11-7\", \"fallback_policy\": \"best_effort\", \"compatibility_ttl_s\": 300, \"streaming_compat\": false, \"cost_bucket\": \"experimental-quant\" }
```
Lina Park: Can we standardize fallback reasons? e.g., `UNSUPPORTED_PRECISION`, `OVERLOAD_CPU`, `OVERLOAD_GPU`, `HOTSWAP` so clients can surface friendly text.
Priya Kapoor: Yes. Also mark `quality_estimate` provenance: `shadow_eval` vs `runtime_estimate`. This matters for trust.
infra-bot: Deployment note: will add discovery endpoint and new telemetry fields to the canary stack. Create canary rule: do not enable `economy` fallback_policy in prod until shadow eval passes.
Noah Rivera: Ops checklist for canary: 1) run 1k shadow prompts comparing chosen precision vs baseline; 2) validate `precision_fallback_rate` < 0.5%; 3) perf deltas within expected multipliers.
Ethan Zhao: Docs: add a page \"Precision contract and fallback policies\" with examples and migration tips. Include SDK snippets and error codes.
Lina Park: Action items: Ethan -> SDK PR with schema + helper client; Priya -> telemetry + stream marker design; Noah -> runtime discovery TTL and partial_support shape; Infra-bot -> create alert and canary flags. I'll capture this in the RFC follow-up. Sync tomorrow 9:30am. :thumbsup:
